title: Water the root zone, not the calendar
subcategory: Water the root zone, not the calendar
summary: Decide from soil moisture, plant stage and weather rather than a fixed daily habit.
steps: Check moisture below the surface with a finger, small trowel or moisture observation at several points.
Water slowly until the active root zone is wet; stop when runoff or deep pooling begins.
Water seedlings and new transplants more frequently but in controlled amounts while roots establish.
Prefer morning where practical so foliage and surfaces can dry.
After heat or wind, inspect plants and soil before adding more water; wilting can also come from root damage or saturation.
